switch.label: Section
lang.label: Language
lang.welcome_body: You can change this at any time from the header.
theme.label: Theme
hero.copy: Find visa-sponsoring jobs and volunteer placements worldwide — every industry, every skill level, in one beautifully simple place.
hero.note: Visa sponsorship only · Jobs and volunteer · Free to use
home.latest_copy: Fresh listings from official job APIs and employer ATS boards. Every role passes our visa check.
home.volunteer_copy: A separate section for humanitarian, environmental, education and community placements that help with your visa. Never mixed with paid jobs.
home.tools_title: AI tools that tell the truth
home.tools_copy: Generate a CV and cover letter tailored to a listing using only your real experience. No invented employers, degrees or dates.
home.trust_copy: Visa decisions come from official sponsor registers and explicit posting language, not guesswork. The AI only handles genuinely ambiguous cases within a small background quota.
jobs.title: Visa-sponsoring jobs
jobs.subtitle: Every industry and skill level, filtered to roles that state sponsorship or come from a verified sponsor.
jobs.no_results: No sponsored roles match these filters
jobs.no_results_hint: Try a broader keyword, another country, or reset the filters. New roles are ingested every few minutes.
visa.confirm: Always confirm visa sponsorship with the employer.
visa.verified_explain: This employer appears in an official government sponsor register for the job's country. A licence does not guarantee this specific role qualifies.
visa.mentioned_explain: The posting explicitly mentions visa sponsorship, relocation support or a work permit.
volunteer.title: Volunteer with visa support
volunteer.subtitle: Unpaid or stipend-only placements with documented visa or invitation support. Paid internships stay in the jobs section.
volunteer.legal: Volunteering abroad often requires a specific visa. A tourist visa may not allow it. Confirm with the organisation and the relevant embassy.
volunteer.fee_toggle: Include programmes that charge a fee
volunteer.no_results: No volunteer placements match these filters
volunteer.no_results_hint: Try another cause area or country. Fee-charging programmes are hidden unless you include them.
volunteer.fee_notice: This programme charges a participation fee. Never pay a “visa fee” or “placement fee” to an individual.
auth.invalid: That email and password do not match.
auth.email_taken: An account with that email already exists.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.contact_note: Contact details are stored in our database only. They are never sent to the AI model; the server inserts them after generation.
profile.headline: Professional headline
profile.upload_hint: PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown · up to 5 MB. We extract the structure; contact details stay on our server.
profile.parsed: Your CV was read. Review every field before saving.
profile.parse_error: We could not read that file. Try a text-based PDF or DOCX.
profile.delete_warning: This removes your profile, saved roles, documents, chat history and account from our database. It cannot be undone. We cannot delete content the AI provider may already have received.
profile.experience_hint: One role per line: Job title | Company | Start – End | Achievement
profile.education_hint: One qualification per line: Degree | Institution | Year
profile.login_required: Sign in to use your profile, saved roles and documents.
docs.title: My documents
docs.none: No saved documents yet. Generate one from any listing.
docgen.include_relocation: Include a relocation and visa paragraph
docgen.hiring_manager_hint: Optional. We never guess a name.
docgen.instruction: Tell the AI what to change
docgen.instruction_hint: For example: make it shorter, more formal, emphasise teamwork
docgen.gaps_hint: These are suggestions to strengthen your profile — never invented into your CV.
docgen.needs_profile: Complete your profile before generating a document.
docgen.verify_warning: Some details could not be verified against your profile. Please review the highlighted lines.
docgen.edit_hint: Edit any text before exporting. Editing and re-downloading never uses AI.
agent.title: Career assistant
agent.welcome: Hi — ask me anything about jobs, volunteering, visas, your CV, or moving abroad. I can search this site for you.
agent.quota_exhausted: The free AI quota is used up. Search, Apply and your saved documents still work. It resets {when}.
agent.disclaimer: General information, not legal or immigration advice.
agent.error: I could not answer that just now. Please try again.
ai.privacy_free: These features use Google's Gemini API on the free tier. Google may use submitted content to improve its products, and human reviewers may read it. Do not type passport numbers, ID numbers or home addresses. Contact details from your profile are never sent; we add them after generation.
ai.privacy_paid: These features use Google's Gemini API on a paid tier. Content is handled under Google's paid-tier terms. Contact details from your profile are never sent; we add them after generation.
ai.ack_required: Please acknowledge the privacy notice first.
ai.disabled: AI features are not configured on this server. Everything else works normally.
errors.404_body: That page does not exist. Try the job search instead.
errors.500_body: We have logged the problem. The rest of the site is still available.
errors.429_body: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.dead_title: This listing is no longer available
errors.dead_body: The employer's application page is closed or expired. Here are similar sponsored listings.
search.translated: Your search was translated to find more listings.
search.no_translation: No listings matched. Try fewer words or a different spelling.
footer.tagline: Visa-sponsoring jobs and volunteer placements, worldwide.
footer.disclaimer: Listings come from official APIs and employer boards. Always confirm visa sponsorship and application details with the employer. Nothing here is legal or immigration advice.
footer.attribution: Job data includes content from Adzuna, Arbeitnow, Jooble, Reed, Remotive, RemoteOK, Jobicy, Himalayas, The Muse and ReliefWeb under their respective terms.
legal.title: Legal and privacy
legal.ai_body: The CV, cover letter, volunteer motivation letter, translation and career assistant features use Google Gemini. When GEMINI_FREE_TIER is true, Google may use submitted content to improve its products and human reviewers may read it. We never send your email address, phone number, street address, ID or passport numbers, or exact date of birth. Those details are inserted by our server after the AI responds.
legal.data_body: Your account email, a hashed password, your profile, saved listings, generated documents, chat history and daily AI usage counters. Application clicks are logged in aggregate to keep listings healthy.
legal.delete_body: Use “Delete my data” on your profile. We remove your profile, documents and chat history from our database. We cannot delete content the AI provider may already have received.
legal.disclaimer_body: Visa and immigration information is general and may be out of date. Sponsor registers show that an employer is licensed, not that a specific role qualifies. Always confirm with the employer and the relevant authority.
countries.title: Country guides and official portals
countries.subtitle: Official public employment portals, visa routes and practical notes for each country.
tools.title: Career tools
tools.subtitle: A profile you control, documents that never invent experience, and an assistant that answers free-form questions.
